newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim, Stalexport set up firm.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim, Stalexport set up firm.

text.p: Polish industrial and trading firm Elektrim SA and steel trader Stalexport set up a firm to acquire a stake in state-owned heating appliances maker Selfa in exchange for Selfa's debts, an Elektrim official said.

Elektrim's investment director Ludwik Eider said the firm, where Elektrim and Stalexport hold 50-percent stakes each, would then set up a joint venture with the treasury which would bring in the assets of the liquidated Selfa.

After the joint venture with the treasury is formed the share capital of Zaklady Sprzetu Elektrogrzejnego Selfa, based in Szczecin, northern Poland, would be increased to several million zlotys from the current 20,000 zlotys.
After the new issue the treasury would hold a 36 percent stake in the firm, of which employees would get 15 percent and Stalexport and Elektrim 32 percent each.
